Reducto API

# One API for
every document

Parse, extract, classify, split, and edit 30+ file types. Production-ready structured JSON in minutes, not months.

Get your API keyRead the docs

[Button: Python][Button: Node.js][Button: cURL]
    
    `from reducto import Reducto
    
    client = Reducto()
    result = client.parse.run(
        input="https://cdn.reducto.ai/samples/fidelity-example.pdf",
        settings={"model": "r-1"},
    )
    
    for chunk in result.result.chunks:
        print(chunk.content)`

pages.text: Developers | Reducto â The Agentic Document Platform API Product Industries Customers Resources Pricing Introducing the Reducto Office SDK: read, edit and render Word, PowerPoint and Excel files in your product Reducto API One API for every document Parse, extract, classify, split, and edit 30+ file types. Production-ready structured JSON in minutes, not months. Get your API key Read the docs Python Node.js cURL from reducto import Reducto client = Reducto() result = client.parse.run( input = "https://cdn.reducto.ai/samples/fidelity-example.pdf" , settings = { "model" : "r-1" }, ) for chunk in result.result.chunks: print (chunk.content) 01 Get your API key Sign up at studio.reducto.ai and create an API key. Set it as an environment variable. export REDUCTO_API_KEY = "your_api_key_here" 02 Install the SDK Python Node.js Go pip install reductoai 03 Parse your first document A few lines of code to convert any document into structured JSON with text, tables, and figures. Python Node.js cURL from reducto import Reducto client = Reducto() result = client.parse.run( input = "https://cdn.reducto.ai/samples/fidelity-example.pdf" , settings = { "model" : "r-1" }, ) print ( f "Processed { result.usage.num_pages } pages" ) for chunk in result.result.chunks: print (chunk.content) 04 Use the structured output Every response returns chunks with typed blocks (Title, Table, Text, Figure) plus bounding box coordinates and a link to inspect results in Studio. { "job_id" : "5df31070-..." , "usage" : { "num_pages" : 3 }, "result" : { "chunks" : [{ "content" : "## Your Portfolio Value: $274,222.20 \n ..." , "blocks" : [{ "type" : "Table" , "bbox" : { "page" : 1 , "left" : 0.516 } }] }] }, "studio_link" : "https://studio.reducto.ai/job/..." } View the full quickstart guide Parse /parse Convert any document into structured JSON with text, tables, and figures. Layout-aware chunking optimized for LLMs. Extract /extract Define a JSON schema and pull specific fields from documents. Get exactly the data you need, nothing more. Classify /classify Route documents by type before processing. Define categories in natural language, no training data required. Split /split Divide documents into logical sections using natural language descriptions for targeted downstream processing. Edit /edit Fill PDF forms and modify DOCX files programmatically with natural language instructions. Studio Build, test, and deploy document workflows visually. Inspect results with bounding-box-level citations. SDKs First-class clients for Python, Node.js, and Go with full type safety. Install and authenticate in seconds. View SDK docs CLI Parse, extract, and manage documents from your terminal. Pipe output into other tools or scripts. View CLI docs MCP Server Connect AI agents to Reducto via the Model Context Protocol. Works with Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and more. View MCP docs Enterprise Grade Built for production 5B+ pages processed. Autoscaling infrastructure with dedicated support for enterprise customers. SOC 2 Type II & HIPAA Audited security controls with BAA available on Growth and Enterprise tiers. Deploy anywhere SaaS, hybrid VPC, full VPC, or air-gapped on-premises. EU and AU regional endpoints available. Zero data retention Zero data retention policy available. 99.9%+ uptime SLA with dedicated enterprise support.
